title: Go to Gram's
summary: Decide when to go, then lock up and leave. Use the Load-out list to pack and the Arrival list when you get there.

title: Stay home (shelter in place)
summary: Stay inside and make the house your shelter when leaving is not the plan.

title: Power outage
summary: Keep the food, medicine and phones safe while the lights are out.

title: Boil-water advisory
summary: What to do when the tap may not be safe. In January 2025, Richmond's water plant failure hit Henrico.

title: Hurricane or tropical storm
summary: Henrico is inland, but wind, flooding and tornadoes reach this far.

title: Winter storm or ice
summary: Cold, ice and possible multi-day outages. Heat the house safely and stay off the roads.

title: Extreme heat
summary: Heat of 90°F or more for two to three days. Cool off, drink fluids and watch the insulin.

title: Tornado
summary: Know your shelter before the warning, then get there fast.

title: Flood
summary: Turn around, don't drown. Get to higher ground and stay out of the water.

title: Nuclear plant accident or fallout
summary: Get inside, stay inside, stay tuned. Take potassium iodide only if officials say so.

title: Wildfire smoke
summary: Keep smoke out of the house and limit your time in it, especially with diabetes, asthma or heart disease.
